import sys
import logging
import argparse
from dd4hep.simulation import DD4hepSimulation, GeneratorAction, MagneticField
from dd4hep.simulation import enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo, _kernel_terminate
from dd4hep.simulation import addParametersToRunHeader, setupTrackingField, setupUserPhysics
from dd4hep.simulation import commandsPreRun, commandsPostRun, commandsInitialize, commandsTerminate
from dd4hep.simulation import mapActions, kernel, run, _configureDD4HEP
from dd4hep.simulation import get_unbound_function

def display_help():
    help_text = """
DD4hep Simulation Help

Usage:
    python simulation.py [options]

Options:
    -h, --help              Show this help message and exit
    --geometry FILE         Path to the detector geometry XML file
    --events N              Number of events to simulate
    --vis                   Enable visualization
    --random-seed SEED      Set random seed
    --output FILE           Output file name
    --field FILE            Magnetic field configuration file
    --physics-list NAME     Physics list to use
    --range-cut VALUE       Global range cut value (mm)
    --generator NAME        Event generator to use
    --log-level LEVEL       Logging level (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR)
"""
    print(help_text)

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
    parser.add_argument('-h', '--help', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--geometry', type=str, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--events', type=int, default=10)
    parser.add_argument('--vis', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--random-seed', type=int, default=None)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=str, default='output.root')
    parser.add_argument('--field', type=str, default=None)
    parser.add_argument('--physics-list', type=str, default='FTFP_BERT')
    parser.add_argument('--range-cut', type=float, default=0.1)
    parser.add_argument('--generator', type=str, default='particleGun')
    parser.add_argument('--log-level', type=str, default='INFO')
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.help:
        display_help()
        sys.exit(0)

    # Setup logger
    logging.basicConfig(level=getattr(logging, args.log_level.upper(), logging.INFO))
    logger = logging.getLogger("DD4hepSimulation")
    logger.info("Starting DD4hep simulation setup...")

    # Configure DD4hep simulation
    sim = DD4hepSimulation()
    _configureDD4HEP(sim)

    # Load geometry
    logger.info(f"Loading geometry from {args.geometry}")
    sim.loadGeometry(args.geometry)

    # Setup magnetic field
    if args.field:
        logger.info(f"Setting up magnetic field from {args.field}")
        field = MagneticField(args.field)
        setupTrackingField(sim, field)
    else:
        logger.info("No magnetic field configuration provided.")

    # Setup random generator
    if args.random_seed is not None:
        logger.info(f"Setting random seed: {args.random_seed}")
        sim.setRandomSeed(args.random_seed)

    # Setup event generator
    logger.info(f"Setting up event generator: {args.generator}")
    generator_action = GeneratorAction(args.generator)
    sim.addAction(generator_action)

    # Setup event actions
    logger.info("Setting up event actions")
    mapActions(sim)

    # Setup I/O
    logger.info(f"Setting up output: {args.output}")
    sim.setOutputFile(args.output)

    # Enable detailed hits and particle info
    enableDetailedHitsAndParticleInfo(sim)

    # Setup detectors
    logger.info("Setting up detectors")
    sim.setupDetectors()

    # Build physics list
    logger.info(f"Building physics list: {args.physics_list}")
    setupUserPhysics(sim, args.physics_list)

    # Add special particle types
    logger.info("Adding special particle types")
    sim.addSpecialParticles()

    # Set global range cut
    logger.info(f"Setting global range cut: {args.range_cut} mm")
    sim.setRangeCut(args.range_cut)

    # Add parameters to run header
    addParametersToRunHeader(sim, {
        "geometry": args.geometry,
        "events": args.events,
        "output": args.output,
        "physics_list": args.physics_list,
        "range_cut": args.range_cut,
        "generator": args.generator,
        "random_seed": args.random_seed,
        "field": args.field
    })

    # Visualization commands
    if args.vis:
        logger.info("Visualization enabled")
        sim.addPreInitCommand("/vis/open OGL")
        sim.addPreInitCommand("/vis/drawVolume")
        sim.addPreInitCommand("/vis/viewer/set/viewpointThetaPhi 30 30")
        sim.addPreInitCommand("/vis/scene/add/trajectories smooth")
        sim.addPreInitCommand("/vis/scene/endOfEventAction accumulate")

    # Pre-run commands
    commandsPreRun(sim)

    # Initialize kernel
    logger.info("Initializing kernel")
    commandsInitialize(sim)
    kernel(sim).initialize()

    # Run simulation
    logger.info(f"Running simulation for {args.events} events")
    run(sim, args.events)

    # Post-run commands
    commandsPostRun(sim)

    # Terminate kernel
    logger.info("Terminating kernel")
    commandsTerminate(sim)
    _kernel_terminate(sim)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
